metadata.reference_policy: Fresh untyped Lambda references for six AWFY rows only. Historical cross-engine cells remain in Result6.
limitations: Only the six AWFY class workloads have fresh untyped Lambda reference times; Node and full LambdaJS were not measured in these captures.
The fresh control includes the class implementation and is not the Result6 candidate. Confirm6-old uses the exact Result6 candidate separately.
MVP class timing includes initialization and setup; Lambda uses its existing benchmark() interval. Towers and Queens have storage or validation differences.
Fifteen-round headline cells are preserved; 60-pair confirmations do not replace them.
No slowdown is confirmed in the fresh-control follow-ups; spectralnorm remains noisy and small effects are unresolved.
Benchmark output checks do not replace semantic, forced-GC, Lambda baseline or Test262 validation; those suites were not run in this tuning round.
metadata.artifact_policy: Recorded from existing accepted captures; no benchmark or test rerun for this publication.
